+@test "spike: a report validated on a spike checkout WARNs that it belongs on the working branch" {
+    git init -q "$WORK/repo"
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    spike_report > "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: this checkout is on spike/ceiling-ui"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- SP-1 cases that need a git checkout ------------------------------------------
+
+spike_repo() {
+    REPO="$WORK/repo"
+    git init -q "$REPO"
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.email t@t
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.name t
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    BASE="$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m "prototype"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: gh pr create with no head is blocked on a spike branch and allowed on the working branch" {
+    spike_repo
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q spike/ceiling-ui
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    # an explicit non-spike head is the operator's statement: not judged by branch
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --head feature/x --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: the block message names the allowed forms and the working-branch rule" {
+    run hook_in "$WORK" "git merge spike/ceiling-ui"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"git push -u origin spike/<slug>"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"on the working branch"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------
+
+skip_without_yq4() {
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+    yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.' || skip "needs mikefarah yq v4"
+}
+
+# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
+write_ledger() {
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
+schema_version: 1
+decisions:
+  - id: "DEC-0042"
+    status: "$1"
+    source: "$2"
+    transitions:
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z", from: null, to: open, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}
+EOF
+}
+
+force_delete() {
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: force-deleting an unmerged spike branch is blocked without a ledger row" {
+    spike_repo
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [FR-1.1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"whose verdict row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a decided verdict row (operator step) for the spike's report allows the delete" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a proposed row, an agent decided step, or another spike's row keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/unattended-prototype.bats: the prototype route in the planning

+#

+# the config example documents interview.unattended_prototype with both values
+# and the default, each planning skill carries the interview rule in at most
+# two lines, and the sequencing guidance points at prototype tickets.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    CONFIG="$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml.example"
+    SKILLS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills"
+}
+
+# The interview block's unattended_prototype comment and key, as text.
+prototype_block() {
+    awk '/^interview:/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { on = 0 } on' "$CONFIG" \
+        | awk '/Prototype-class questions/ { on = 1 } on { print } on && /^  unattended_prototype:/ { exit }'
+}
+
+@test "config example: interview.unattended_prototype defaults to defer" {
+    if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.'; then
+        [ "$(yq '.interview.unattended_prototype' "$CONFIG")" = "defer" ]
+    fi
+    grep -qE '^  unattended_prototype: defer[[:space:]]+# defer \| halt$' "$CONFIG"
+}
+
+@test "config example: both values are documented with their semantics" {
+    local block; block="$(prototype_block)"
+    [[ -n "$block" ]]
+    # defer: the bead, the open row, the PRD Deferred line, and planning continues
+    [[ "$block" == *"defer (default)"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"decision:prototype bead"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"open DEC row"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"**Deferred:** pending prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"continue planning"* ]]
+    # halt: the same bead and row, then planning stops with the documented message
+    [[ "$block" == *"halt: create the same bead and row, then stop planning"* ]]
+    [[ "$block" == *"planning halted: prototype <bead-id> (DEC-NNNN)"* ]]

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/spike-validator.bats: the spike discipline (grimoires/loa/sdd.md
+# D-5.4, D-5.5, D-5.9).
+#
+#   validate-artifact.sh --type spike: the template passes; an empty Verdict,
+#   a missing section, a Pointer without a branch or path, a Decided by naming
+#   neither operator nor agent, a non-spike Branch header and a URL fail.
+#   block-destructive-bash.sh: SP-1 cases that need a git checkout (gh pr
+#   create with no head on a spike branch), and the spike-delete predicate:
+#   force-deleting spike/<slug> passes only with a decided verdict row.
+# The command-string shapes of SP-1 live in the fence corpus
+# (tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl, rows B50-B59 and D61-D72).
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md"
+    HOOK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
+    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
+    export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$WORK/audit"
+    mkdir -p "$LOA_REPO_ROOT"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    cd /
+    rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# A filled-in report.
+spike_report() {
+    cat <<'EOF'
+# Spike: ceiling-ui
+
+**Bead**: bd-p1
+**Branch**: spike/ceiling-ui
+**Date**: 2026-10-14
+
+## Question
+Does the ceiling table read better as a chart?
+
+## What was built
+A static page rendering both forms from one fixture.
+
+## Verdict
+The chart, with the table behind a toggle.
+
+## Pointer
+Branch spike/ceiling-ui at commit 1a2b3c4.
+
+## Decided by
+operator, recorded as DEC-0042.
+EOF
+}
+
+# Replace the body of section $1 in stdin with $2 (empty: drop the body).
+with_section() {
+    awk -v want="## $1" -v repl="$2" '
+        $0 == want { print; if (repl != "") print repl; skip = 1; next }
+        skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+        !skip { print }
+    '
+}
+
+hook_in() {
+    local dir="$1" cmd="$2"
+    (cd "$dir" && jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}' | bash "$HOOK")
+}
+
+# --- validate-artifact.sh --type spike ------------------------------------------
+
+@test "spike: the shipped template passes" {
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$TEMPLATE"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a filled-in report passes without warnings" {
+    spike_report > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: an empty Verdict fails (template and report)" {
+    with_section "Verdict" "" < "$TEMPLATE" > "$WORK/t.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/t.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" "" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: each missing section is named" {
+    local s
+    for s in "Question" "What was built" "Verdict" "Pointer" "Decided by"; do
+        spike_report | grep -vxF "## $s" > "$WORK/r.md"
+        run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+        [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+        [[ "$output" == *"missing section '## $s'"* ]]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Pointer naming neither a spike branch nor a path fails; a path passes" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "the prototype we looked at" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Pointer' names neither"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "prototypes/ceiling/index.html" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: Decided by must name operator or agent; a missing DEC id WARNs" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "the team, DEC-0042" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"names neither operator nor agent"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "agent" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Decided by' cites no DEC row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Branch header that is not spike/<slug> fails; a multi-line Verdict WARNs" {
+    spike_report | sed 's#^\*\*Branch\*\*: spike/ceiling-ui#**Branch**: feature/ceiling-ui#' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"is not a spike/<slug> branch"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" $'The chart.\nAlso the table.' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Verdict' has 2 lines"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a URL fails (plain prose)" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "spike/ceiling-ui, demo at https://example.invalid/demo" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"a URL in the document"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a report validated on a spike checkout WARNs that it belongs on the working branch" {
+    git init -q "$WORK/repo"
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    spike_report > "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: this checkout is on spike/ceiling-ui"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- SP-1 cases that need a git checkout ------------------------------------------
+
+spike_repo() {
+    REPO="$WORK/repo"
+    git init -q "$REPO"
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.email t@t
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.name t
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    BASE="$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m "prototype"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: gh pr create with no head is blocked on a spike branch and allowed on the working branch" {
+    spike_repo
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q spike/ceiling-ui
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    # an explicit non-spike head is the operator's statement: not judged by branch
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --head feature/x --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: the block message names the allowed forms and the working-branch rule" {
+    run hook_in "$WORK" "git merge spike/ceiling-ui"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"git push -u origin spike/<slug>"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"on the working branch"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------
+
+skip_without_yq4() {
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+    yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.' || skip "needs mikefarah yq v4"
+}
+
+# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
+write_ledger() {
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
+schema_version: 1
+decisions:
+  - id: "DEC-0042"
+    status: "$1"
+    source: "$2"
+    transitions:
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z", from: null, to: open, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}
+EOF
+}
+
+force_delete() {
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: force-deleting an unmerged spike branch is blocked without a ledger row" {
+    spike_repo
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [FR-1.1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"whose verdict row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a decided verdict row (operator step) for the spike's report allows the delete" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a proposed row, an agent decided step, or another spike's row keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}

+prototype_block() {
+    awk '/^interview:/ { on = 1; next } on && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { on = 0 } on' "$CONFIG" \

+    [[ "$block" == *"open DEC row"* ]]

+#!/usr/bin/env bats

+# tests/unit/spike-validator.bats: the spike discipline (grimoires/loa/sdd.md

+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md"
+    HOOK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"

+}
+
+teardown() {
+    cd /
+    rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# A filled-in report.
+spike_report() {
+    cat <<'EOF'
+# Spike: ceiling-ui
+
+**Bead**: bd-p1
+**Branch**: spike/ceiling-ui
+**Date**: 2026-10-14
+
+## Question
+Does the ceiling table read better as a chart?
+
+## What was built
+A static page rendering both forms from one fixture.
+
+## Verdict
+The chart, with the table behind a toggle.
+
+## Pointer
+Branch spike/ceiling-ui at commit 1a2b3c4.
+
+## Decided by
+operator, recorded as DEC-0042.
+EOF
+}
+
+# Replace the body of section $1 in stdin with $2 (empty: drop the body).
+with_section() {
+    awk -v want="## $1" -v repl="$2" '
+        $0 == want { print; if (repl != "") print repl; skip = 1; next }
+        skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+        !skip { print }
+    '
+}
+
+hook_in() {
+    local dir="$1" cmd="$2"
+    (cd "$dir" && jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}' | bash "$HOOK")
+}

+# --- validate-artifact.sh --type spike ------------------------------------------
+
+@test "spike: the shipped template passes" {
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$TEMPLATE"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a filled-in report passes without warnings" {
+    spike_report > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN"* ]]
+}

+@test "spike: an empty Verdict fails (template and report)" {

+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+}

+@test "spike: each missing section is named" {

+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"

+
+@test "spike: a URL fails (plain prose)" {

+    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init

+# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------

+skip_without_yq4() {
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"

+# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
+write_ledger() {
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
+schema_version: 1
+decisions:
+  - id: "DEC-0042"
+    status: "$1"
+    source: "$2"
+    transitions:

+      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}

+}

+    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
+}

+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}

+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]

+    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"

+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}

+# (tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl, rows B50-B59 and D61-D72).
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    VALIDATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    TEMPLATE="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md"
+    HOOK="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
+    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not installed"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
+    export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$WORK/audit"
+    mkdir -p "$LOA_REPO_ROOT"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    cd /
+    rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# A filled-in report.
+spike_report() {
+    cat <<'EOF'
+# Spike: ceiling-ui
+
+**Bead**: bd-p1
+**Branch**: spike/ceiling-ui
+**Date**: 2026-10-14
+
+## Question
+Does the ceiling table read better as a chart?
+
+## What was built
+A static page rendering both forms from one fixture.
+
+## Verdict
+The chart, with the table behind a toggle.
+
+## Pointer
+Branch spike/ceiling-ui at commit 1a2b3c4.
+
+## Decided by
+operator, recorded as DEC-0042.
+EOF
+}
+
+# Replace the body of section $1 in stdin with $2 (empty: drop the body).
+with_section() {
+    awk -v want="## $1" -v repl="$2" '
+        $0 == want { print; if (repl != "") print repl; skip = 1; next }
+        skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+        !skip { print }
+    '
+}
+
+hook_in() {
+    local dir="$1" cmd="$2"
+    (cd "$dir" && jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}' | bash "$HOOK")
+}
+
+# --- validate-artifact.sh --type spike ------------------------------------------
+
+@test "spike: the shipped template passes" {
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$TEMPLATE"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a filled-in report passes without warnings" {
+    spike_report > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: an empty Verdict fails (template and report)" {
+    with_section "Verdict" "" < "$TEMPLATE" > "$WORK/t.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/t.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" "" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Verdict' is empty"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: each missing section is named" {
+    local s
+    for s in "Question" "What was built" "Verdict" "Pointer" "Decided by"; do
+        spike_report | grep -vxF "## $s" > "$WORK/r.md"
+        run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+        [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+        [[ "$output" == *"missing section '## $s'"* ]]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Pointer naming neither a spike branch nor a path fails; a path passes" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "the prototype we looked at" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"'## Pointer' names neither"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "prototypes/ceiling/index.html" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "spike: Decided by must name operator or agent; a missing DEC id WARNs" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "the team, DEC-0042" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"names neither operator nor agent"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Decided by" "agent" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Decided by' cites no DEC row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a Branch header that is not spike/<slug> fails; a multi-line Verdict WARNs" {
+    spike_report | sed 's#^\*\*Branch\*\*: spike/ceiling-ui#**Branch**: feature/ceiling-ui#' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"is not a spike/<slug> branch"* ]]
+    spike_report | with_section "Verdict" $'The chart.\nAlso the table.' > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: '## Verdict' has 2 lines"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a URL fails (plain prose)" {
+    spike_report | with_section "Pointer" "spike/ceiling-ui, demo at https://example.invalid/demo" > "$WORK/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"a URL in the document"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spike: a report validated on a spike checkout WARNs that it belongs on the working branch" {
+    git init -q "$WORK/repo"
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    git -C "$WORK/repo" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    spike_report > "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    run "$VALIDATE" --type spike --file "$WORK/repo/r.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: this checkout is on spike/ceiling-ui"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- SP-1 cases that need a git checkout ------------------------------------------
+
+spike_repo() {
+    REPO="$WORK/repo"
+    git init -q "$REPO"
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.email t@t
+    git -C "$REPO" config user.name t
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m init
+    BASE="$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b spike/ceiling-ui
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m "prototype"
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: gh pr create with no head is blocked on a spike branch and allowed on the working branch" {
+    spike_repo
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q spike/ceiling-ui
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    # an explicit non-spike head is the operator's statement: not judged by branch
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "gh pr create --draft --head feature/x --title t --body b"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SP-1: the block message names the allowed forms and the working-branch rule" {
+    run hook_in "$WORK" "git merge spike/ceiling-ui"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [SP-1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"git push -u origin spike/<slug>"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"on the working branch"* ]]
+}
+
+# --- the spike-delete predicate (D-5.9) -------------------------------------------
+
+skip_without_yq4() {
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+    yq --version 2>&1 | grep -q 'mikefarah.*version v4\.' || skip "needs mikefarah yq v4"
+}
+
+# write_ledger <status> <source> <by-of-the-decided-step>
+write_ledger() {
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    cat > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml" <<EOF
+schema_version: 1
+decisions:
+  - id: "DEC-0042"
+    status: "$1"
+    source: "$2"
+    transitions:
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z", from: null, to: open, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T01:00:00Z", from: open, to: proposed, by: "agent:chart"}
+      - {at: "2026-10-14T02:00:00Z", from: proposed, to: decided, by: "$3"}
+EOF
+}
+
+force_delete() {
+    run hook_in "$REPO" "git branch -D $*"
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: force-deleting an unmerged spike branch is blocked without a ledger row" {
+    spike_repo
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"BLOCKED [FR-1.1]"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"whose verdict row"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a decided verdict row (operator step) for the spike's report allows the delete" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md#verdict" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: a proposed row, an agent decided step, or another spike's row keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    write_ledger proposed "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "agent:chart"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/other.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: every name must qualify; an unmerged non-spike branch beside a decided spike keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q -b feature/wip
+    git -C "$REPO" commit -q --allow-empty -m wip
+    git -C "$REPO" checkout -q "$BASE"
+    write_ledger decided "grimoires/loa/spikes/ceiling-ui.md" "operator:decisions-command"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui feature/wip
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" {
+    skip_without_yq4
+    spike_repo
+    mkdir -p "$REPO/grimoires/loa"
+    printf 'decisions: [unclosed\n' > "$REPO/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
+    force_delete spike/ceiling-ui
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}

hook() { jq -cn --arg c "$1" '{tool_input:{command:$c}}' | bash "$H" 2>&1; }

echo "=== corpus rows"
grep -E '"id":"(B5[0-9]|D6[1-9]|D7[0-2])"' "$CORPUS" | while IFS= read -r row; do
  id=$(jq -r .id <<<"$row"); cmd=$(jq -r .cmd <<<"$row"); exp=$(jq -r .expect <<<"$row")
  out=$(hook "$cmd"); rc=$?

done

  'git merge "spike/x"'

  "git switch -c new spike/x"

  "git checkout -B spike/x"

  "git restore --source=spike/x a"

  "git merge spike/x --no-commit"
  "git format-patch main..spike/x && git am *.patch"

content.content:
# br CLI Flags & JSON Schema Summary

## Documented Subcommand Flags

**`br ready`**: No mention of `--parent`, `--type`, `--unassigned`, or `--limit` in the README. The docs show `br ready`, `br ready --brief --json`, and `br ready --include-deferred`.

**`br create`**: Documented flags include `--type`, `--priority`, `--description`. The README shows: `"br create \"Title\" -p 1 --type bug"` and `"br create \"Implement user auth\" --type feature --priority 1"`. No `--parent`, `--labels`, `--external-ref`, `--slug`, `--dry-run`, or `--json` mentioned for create.

**`br update`**: Shown with `--priority`, `--status`, `--assignee`. No explicit mention of `--claim`, `--add-label`, or `--external-ref`.

**`br list`**: Documented as `"br list --status open --priority 0-1"` and `"br list --json"`. The `--fields` flag is mentioned: `"br list --json --fields id,title,priority"`. No `--all`, `--type`, or `--limit` explicitly documented.

**`br dep add`**: Simple syntax shown: `"br dep add br-child br-parent"`.

**`br comments add`**: Format: `"br comments add br-abc123 \"Found root cause\""`.

**`br close`**: Example: `"br close br-abc123 --reason \"Done\""`.

**`br show`**: Example: `"br show br-abc123 --json"`.

## JSON Output Shapes

**`br list --json`**: Returns an object with structure: `{"issues", "total", "limit", "offset", "has_more"}` (per the design philosophy section: "Structured output for tools ({issues, total, limit, offset, has_more})").

**`br show --json`**: Returns a single issue object. The README states: `"br show --json` also exposes a derived `rollup` for any issue with local children (`{\"status\": \"in_progress\", \"descendants\": {...}}`)"`.

## Parent-Child Relationships

Parent issues are recorded via **parent-child dependencies using `parent-child` edges**, not a direct `parent` field. The docs state: `"Only `parent-child` edges participate"` when discussing capacity hierarchy. Child IDs follow the pattern `<parent>.1`, `<parent>.2`, etc.

--- mutation-logger: logs every Bash call or only mutations?

# If we can't parse, skip silently
if [[ -z "$command" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only log mutating commands (skip read-only operations)
# Handles: direct commands, prefixed (sudo, env, command), and chained (&&, ;, |)
# perf pass-9: was `echo "$command" | grep -qEi '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*(sudo\s+)?...'`
# — same pattern, \s spelled [[:space:]], tested per line against the
# C-locale-folded command (see header note).
_ml_re='(^|&&|;|\|)[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(env[[:space:]]+[^ ]+[[:space:]]+)?(command[[:space:]]+)?(git|npm|pip|cargo|rm|mv|cp|mkdir|chmod|chown|docker|kubectl|make|yarn|pnpm|npx)[[:space:]]'
_ml_hit=0
_ml_lc="${command,,}"
_ml_lines=()
if [[ "$_ml_lc" == *$'\n'* ]]; then
  mapfile -t _ml_lines <<<"${_ml_lc%$'\n'}"
else
  _ml_lines=("$_ml_lc")
fi
for _ml_l in "${_ml_lines[@]}"; do
  if [[ "$_ml_l" =~ $_ml_re ]]; then
    _ml_hit=1
    break
  fi
done
if [[ "$_ml_hit" -eq 1 ]]; then
  # Create .run directory if needed (perf pass-4: [[ -d ]] guard skips the
  # mkdir spawn in the steady state where .run already exists)
  [[ -d .run ]] || mkdir -p .run 2>/dev/null || true

  # Append the pre-built JSONL entry (compact, one JSON object per line).
  # Extended schema includes Hounfour-ready fields (empty string when not set).
  # Populated from environment variables if present:
  #   LOA_CURRENT_MODEL, LOA_CURRENT_PROVIDER, LOA_TRACE_ID
  #   LOA_TEAM_ID, LOA_TEAM_MEMBER (Agent Teams identity, v1.39.0)
  # This follows the OpenTelemetry principle: define the trace schema before
  # the instrumentation exists.
  if [[ -n "$audit_line" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$audit_line" >> .run/audit.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    # Builder failed (e.g. non-numeric exit_code): the old `jq -cn ... >>
    # .run/audit.jsonl || true` still OPENED the log via the redirection even
    # when jq emitted nothing — preserve that file-creation side effect.
    : >> .run/audit.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

--- adversarial-review.sh header/options
1:#!/usr/bin/env bash
2:# =============================================================================
3:# adversarial-review.sh — Adversarial cross-model dissent for code review/audit
4:# =============================================================================
5:# Version: 1.0.0
6:# Part of: Adversarial Flatline Protocol (#224)
7:#
8:# Usage:
9:#   adversarial-review.sh --type <review|audit> --sprint-id <id> --diff-file <path> [options]
10:#
11:# Options:
12:#   --type <review|audit>     Dissent type (required)
13:#   --sprint-id <id>          Sprint identifier (required)
14:#   --diff-file <path>        Path to git diff file (required)
15:#   --diff-range <base>...<head>
16:#                             Instead of --diff-file: the script runs `git diff` on the range itself (ref names only)
17:#   --context-file <path>     Reviewer findings (review only; omit for audit independence)
18:#   --model <model>           Dissenter model (default: from config or gpt-5.3-codex)
19:#   --budget <cents>          Max cost in cents (default: from config or 150)
20:#                             cycle-131 FR-4: flatline_protocol.<code_review|security_audit>.budget_scale: fixed | diff
21:#                             (default fixed — an absent key is the shipped gate, envelope unchanged) and budget_cents_max
22:#                             (default 600). diff: the gate's budget is min(max(<this budget>, ceil(estimate × 1.2)),
23:#                             budget_cents_max), estimate = the pre-dispatch estimate over the planned voices; above it
24:#                             the run refuses (exit 4, status budget_exceeded, reason budget). A malformed scale or maximum
25:#                             is said and fixed applies. With the key written the envelope's metadata carries
26:#                             budget_scale, budget_cents_effective, budget_cents_max.
27:#
28:# Findings (cycle-131 FR-4): each finding may carry anchor_line / anchor_line_end (the head-file line, or range, it
29:# sits on) beside the symbol anchor; kept only as whole numbers 1..10,000,000 (end ≥ start), else dropped silently.
30:#   --timeout <seconds>       API timeout (default: from config or 60)
31:#   --dry-run                 Assemble context without calling API
32:#   --json                    Output as JSON (default)
33:#   --record-fallback <status> --reason <text> [--since <ISO-8601 UTC>]
34:#                             Write the failed-run record instead of a review (no --diff-file): status `failed` (the
35:#                             run aborted — never over a standing envelope, unless `--since <the run's start>` shows it
36:#                             older: the previous round's, moved aside) or a pre-lock refusal (`workdir_unavailable`,
37:#                             `nothing_to_review`, `budget_exceeded`, `diff_range_failed` — the previous envelope and
38:#                             sidecars go aside as `.prev`, never one `--since` shows newer); under the run lock, so a live run is refused (`refused_concurrent_run`, exit 2)
39:#
40:# Exit codes:
41:#   0 - Success (findings returned, may be empty)
42:#   1 - Configuration error (disabled, missing config)
43:#   2 - Invalid arguments
44:#   3 - API call failed (all retries exhausted)
45:#   4 - Budget exceeded
46:#   5 - Invalid response (schema validation failed)
47:#   6 - Timeout
48:#
49:# Environment:
50:#   OPENAI_API_KEY            Required for GPT models
51:#   FLATLINE_MOCK_MODE=true   Use mock responses for testing

# Reviewer concerns: sprint-1 (PR: cycle-128 sprint-253 part 2, /chart decision map + prototype-ticket discipline)

Phase 2 notes for the adversarial dissent. The diff is `pr/head.diff`; paths below are under `pr/head/`.

## Verified defects (reproduced)

1. `.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:654-660` — `_fr11_spike_decided` pipes `yq -o=json ... 2>/dev/null | jq -e ...`. The hook has no pipefail (line 14, by design). When yq cannot parse the ledger it prints nothing and jq 1.6 exits 0 on empty input, so the predicate returns 0 and `git branch -D spike/<slug>` on an unmerged spike branch is ALLOWED. Header says "any failed lookup keeps the block". The PR's own test `tests/unit/spike-validator.bats` "D-5.9: an unparsable ledger keeps the block" fails (hook rc 0, expected 2). Reproduced with jq-1.6, yq v4.40.5.
2. `.claude/scripts/chart-guard.sh:7-8,42` and `.claude/commands/chart.md:79-80` claim the guard refuses "an autonomous PRD Status line". It calls `dec-write-lib.sh context --prd`, whose first line follows live signals only (the PRD signal is advisory, printed only under `--why`). With a PRD whose Status says autonomous and no live signal the guard prints `interactive` and passes. Test CD-10 in `tests/unit/charting-decisions.bats:146-150` fails against the PR's own code.
3. `.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:459-467` — `research-end` fails the ticket when any file under `.run/` or `.beads/` is newer than the dispatch marker. The research subagent's one legitimate Write (its report) fires PostToolUse `write-mutation-logger.sh` (settings.json, matcher Write), which appends `.run/audit.jsonl` unconditionally, and `karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh` writes `.run/karpathy-surgical/<key>.jsonl` when the surgical knob is on (profile default true). So every real dispatch fails `research-end` after the report is written. The research flow cannot complete in the shipped harness.

## Suspected defects (from reading)

4. `.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:159-197` — `op_epic` is idempotent only via the map doc: `br create` (line 172) runs before the doc is written (175-195). An interruption or a failed mktemp/mv between them leaves an epic bead with no doc; the re-run creates a second epic (no lookup by slug `map-<slug>`). The documented write-order recovery (REFERENCE.md §Write order) covers tickets only.
5. `.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh:1040` (`DEC-[0-9]{4,}` on Decisions-so-far bullets) and `:1111` (`external_ref` must match `^DEC-[0-9]{4,}$`) reject `PEND-xxxxxxxx` ids, which `chart-ticket.sh` itself writes into the doc line and the bead's external_ref when run in a linked worktree (ROW_RE at chart-ticket.sh:46 accepts PEND-; REFERENCE.md:74-77 acknowledges PEND ids). The skill's step 10 runs this validator, so a map charted in a worktree fails its own validator.
6. `.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:144` — `map_rows` globs `${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../grimoires/loa/a2a/*/decisions-pending.yaml`, not `${ROOT}` / `$G`; under `--root` it reads the real repo's pending files for a fixture tree.
7. `.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:51` — `san1` comment says it strips C1 controls; `tr -d` under LC_ALL=C removes only C0 and DEL (C1 are two-byte UTF-8 sequences).
8. `.claude/scripts/chart-ticket.sh:310` — `cut -c1-200` under LC_ALL=C cuts bytes and can split a multibyte character in the bead comment.
9. `tests/unit/spike-validator.bats:19,75-77,87` — depends on `grimoires/loa/spikes/TEMPLATE.md`, not shipped in this PR; validate-artifact.sh messages also point at it. Unverifiable here (tests 1 and 3 fail without it).
10. SP-1 misses not in the documented list (`block-destructive-bash.sh:835-839`): `git branch -f main spike/x`, `git read-tree spike/x`, `git format-patch main..spike/x | git am` pass. Fence-not-boundary class; documentation gap only.
11. No CHANGELOG entry and no CLAUDE.loa.md mention of the new `/chart` truename in the diff (41 files; AGENTS.md/README counts were bumped).

## Things checked and found sound

- Real `br` CLI (beads_rust src/cli/mod.rs) defines every flag used: ready --parent/--type/--unassigned/--limit; create --parent/--labels/--external-ref/--slug/--description/--dry-run; update --claim/--add-label; list --all/--type/--limit.

AGENTS.md checksum matches. validate-skill-capabilities PASS for charting-decisions.
